The candidate is the count of the taxpayer meeting conditions 1 to 3 (not joint inside the count), with no line 7 > 0 or line 1 > 0 test, so it asks the line 7 age, student and support questions on every non-joint return with Form 8863 lines, including returns with no American opportunity amount and returns stopped at line 4 (the Claude reply's 11 completed witnesses, e.g. classm.s3.2, show such returns) (M3). Project stands.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; The deepseek reply fails the model type check (f8863.clw1, clw2 and clw3: "model changed a published result type"), so triage executed none of it (`../triage/f8863.deepseek.json`, every open line "candidate invalid"); this line is ruled by reading the expression against the source. i8863 p. 7, Line 7: "You don’t qualify for a refundable American opportunity credit if 1 (a, b, or c), 2, and 3 below apply to you." The candidate defines the helper as the box condition itself (the taxpayer meets conditions 1 and 2, line 1 and line 7 above zero, not joint), where the published label is "Line 7 is above zero on a return that is not joint (the line 7 conditions are asked)". The two differ only when line 7 > 0 on a return that is not joint and conditions 1 or 2 fail (project true, candidate false); the helper is not printed and is read only by person.edu_kid and f8863.no_refund, which both also require conditions 1 and 2, so the box, line 8 and line 9 are the same on every return. An intermediate difference that reaches no printed amount. Project stands.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; on the declaration. The deepseek reply fails the host checks (f8863.kid_needed: "malformed expression (project schema): data/all/1/gt/0 must be string ..." and "comparison operands have incompatible types"; M4), so triage executed none of it (`../triage/f8863.deepseek.json`, every open line "candidate invalid"); this line is ruled by reading the expression against the source. The expression puts a sum_over inline as a comparison operand, which the schema rejects, and compares a Count with a Bool expression. By reading, it defines the helper as the line 7 box condition (i8863 p. 7, Line 7, conditions 1 (a, b, or c), 2 and 3: under 24, a parent alive, not joint, with the age, student and support tests read correctly from person.sav_born, edu_born_2007 and edu_born_2002), not the published "Line 7 is above zero on a return that is not joint (the line 7 conditions are asked)"; with no line 7 > 0 test it would ask the taxpayer's age and support questions on every return that is not joint (M3). Project stands.
